title: Anchorage-independent growth assay or Soft Agar assay
author: Marzia Ognibene
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bgeajtae

steps.title: Prepare 5% agarose stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve SeaKem low‑gelling agarose in distilled water to a final concentration of 5% (w/v).

steps.title: Autoclave agarose solution
steps.instruction: Sterilize the 5% agarose solution by autoclaving.

steps.title: Warm 10% serum media
steps.instruction: Place 10% serum‑containing culture medium in a water bath set to 48 °C until warmed.

steps.title: Melt agarose and adjust volume
steps.instruction: Microwave the autoclaved agarose for a few minutes until fully melted; before heating, mark the agar level and, after melting, add distilled water as needed to restore the original level and maintain the correct concentration.

steps.title: Cool and reheat agarose
steps.instruction: Allow the melted agarose to cool at room temperature for 10 minutes, then return it to the 48 °C water bath to keep it liquid.

steps.title: Make 0.6% agar base
steps.instruction: Dilute the liquid agarose with pre‑warmed culture medium to a final agar concentration of 0.6% (w/v) and dispense 4 ml into each p60 plastic plate.

steps.title: Solidify base agar and equilibrate pH
steps.instruction: Let the 0.6% agar plates sit at room temperature for 40 minutes to solidify, then transfer them to a 37 °C CO₂ incubator to allow the plates to adjust to the proper pH.

steps.title: Make 0.3% agar overlay
steps.instruction: Prepare a second agar solution by diluting the melted agarose with pre‑warmed medium to a final concentration of 0.3% (w/v); plan to use 3 ml per p60 plate (or per conical tube as indicated).

steps.title: Prepare cell suspension
steps.instruction: Trypsinize the cells, resuspend them in a minimal volume of medium, count them, and adjust the suspension to the desired cell density for the assay.

steps.title: Add agar to conical tubes
steps.instruction: Aliquot 3 ml of the 0.3% agar solution into each required conical tube.

steps.title: Mix cells into agar overlay
steps.instruction: Add the calculated number of cells to each tube containing 0.3% agar, work quickly, and gently shake the tube to achieve an even cell suspension.

steps.title: Overlay cells onto base agar
steps.instruction: Pour the entire contents of each tube directly onto a previously solidified 0.6% agar plate.

steps.title: Solidify overlay and incubate
steps.instruction: Swirl each plate gently, let the overlay solidify at room temperature for 40 minutes, then place the plates in a 37 °C CO₂ incubator.

steps.title: Feed cells and monitor hydration
steps.instruction: After 24 hours, add 1 ml of 10% serum medium to each plate and check weekly that the agar remains well hydrated.
